title: California Condors Rebounded From 27 To 500
hook: California condors escaped near-extinction, but one threat still dominates.
closing: The rescue worked, but preventing lead poisoning still determines whether recovery lasts.
question: Can condors keep recovering?

segments.say: California condors fell to 27 birds, leaving one disaster capable of erasing the species.
California condors rebounded to 500 birds, proving captive breeding reversed a collapse once considered nearly final.
Lead poisoning causes 50% of known California condor deaths, so recovery still depends on removing that preventable threat.
